  • Method Details

    • getItemSalesAsync

      public CompletableFuture<List<ItemSalesRow>> getItemSalesAsync(LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Loads the sales report: quantity sold and revenue for each item sold from start through end, both days inclusive. Revenue does not include tips.
      Parameters:
      start - first day of the range, required
      end - last day of the range, required, cannot be before start
      Returns:
      future holding one row per item sold, ordered by quantity sold (highest first), then by name. Fails if a date is missing, start is after end, or the query fails.

    • getXReportDataAsync

      public CompletableFuture<XReportData> getXReportDataAsync(LocalDate date)
      Loads the X report data for a specific date.
      Parameters:
      date - the date for which to generate the X report, required
      Returns:
      future holding the X report data for the specified date
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the date is null
      RuntimeException - if the database query fails
